security.trust: Trusted local hotspot. Registration and device sockets are open to its clients; do not use it on shared or venue Wi-Fi.

content.summary: A still image is selected and its bytes are available.

backup.scope: A snapshot contains the database plus only the referenced curated assets and uploads; unused files in the asset directory and unused uploads are excluded.

advice: Screen sleep, auto-lock, and remote wake are tablet-OS decisions. This server cannot wake a sleeping tablet, power one on, or force fullscreen.
The page's Full screen button needs a tap and does not survive a reload or a browser restart.
The Screen Wake Lock API is unavailable on this plain-HTTP origin; keep tablets awake with their own auto-lock and stay-awake settings.
